buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. OEM Authorisation and Manufacturer Credentials Submission of a valid OEM Manufacturer Authorisation Form (MAF), specifically mentioning the GeM Bid Number, is mandatory. The bidder shall be an authorised OEM, OEM-authorised dealer or distributor for the quoted RAM pro ducts. The OEM authorisation must be valid on the date of bid submission. The bidder shall submit an undertaking from the OEM confirming comprehensive warranty support f or a minimum period of 02 years from the date of successful installation/acceptance. 2. Bidder Eligibility and Non-Blacklisting

The bidder shall not have been suspended, blacklisted, banned or debarred by any Central Govern ment Ministry/Department, State Government Department, PSU or Government organisation as on t he date of bid submission. The bidder shall submit a duly signed and stamped undertaking declaring that no such order is curr ently in force against the bidder. Any false declaration or suppression of material information shall make the bidder liable for disqualif ication and further action as per applicable rules. 3. Original OEM Product and Technical Compliance The L1 bidder shall supply only brand-new, genuine and original OEM RAM modules. Refurbished, us ed, repaired, counterfeit or compatible/unbranded products shall not be accepted. The required quantity is as follows: RAM SpecificationQuantity 16 GB RAM 10 Nos. 8 GB RAM 30 Nos. Total 40 Nos. The bidder shall submit OEM product datasheets/catalogues and exact part numbers for both RAM v ariants along with the bid. The supplied RAM shall strictly conform to the technical specifications mentioned in the bid and shal l be compatible with the existing systems. The purchaser reserves the right to verify product authenticity directly with the OEM. 4. Common IP Address and Bid Integrity GeM common IP address checks may be used to identify potential conflicts of interest, multiple bidd ing or collusive practices. Bidders found to have violated applicable GeM provisions relating to common IP addresses, collusio n or unfair trade practices shall be dealt with strictly in accordance with GeM rules and applicable pr ocurement guidelines. Any misrepresentation or submission of forged documents shall result in disqualification and further action as per applicable rules. 5. Warranty and Replacement of Defective Products The supplier shall provide a minimum comprehensive warranty of 02 years for all supplied RAM mo dules. Any RAM module found defective, faulty, damaged or non-functional during inspection, installation o r the warranty period shall be replaced with a new, genuine OEM product immediately, at no additio nal cost to the Academy. The replacement shall carry the applicable warranty coverage and shall not affect the original warra nty obligations. Failure to replace defective products within the stipulated period shall be reported through the GeM Portal for appropriate action, including applicable penalties and other remedies under GeM terms a nd conditions. 6. Verification and Acceptance The Academy reserves the right to inspect, verify and test all supplied RAM modules before accepta nce. The supplier shall produce OEM invoices, serial numbers, warranty details and other supporting doc uments whenever required. Products failing technical verification, compatibility testing or OEM authenticity checks shall be rejec

ted and replaced by the supplier at no additional cost. Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory delivery, verification and acceptance of the suppl ied materials. 7. Undertaking and Compliance The bidder shall submit a signed undertaking confirming compliance with all the above eligibility crit eria and technical requirements. Non-compliance with the prescribed bid conditions, submission of false documents or supply of non- genuine products shall attract action as per applicable GeM terms and conditions and Government p rocurement rules. . 4. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support.
